I told Hollis in the thread on his question in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

Pree first posted Dock 23 in #central-team on Oct 14. She corrected it to Gate 47 later that day because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel since then changes that.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he could already see both of Pree's messages.
